entries.title: Headings, lists and inline formatting
entries.options: Core formatting.marks policies: commands, shortcuts and controls independently. No Heading/List facade factory is promised.
entries.dependencies: Existing v5 engine, prepared command/selection and history owners.
entries.conflicts: Disabling commands requires shortcuts:false and controls:false; hiding controls does not change admission or permissions.
entries.cost: Baseline engine/input/formatting; no dictionary, parser or resolver selected.
entries.input: Project kickoff, Due Friday and two plain agenda paragraphs.
entries.action: Select Friday and invoke the qualified bold command; apply heading/list through the pinned command consumer linked below.
entries.output: Only Friday gains bold; undo restores the original marks and text. Heading/list snapshots remain the qualified historical command examples.
entries.serialization: Existing marks and unknown bounded attributes survive hidden controls. Heading/list changes use the existing engine block attributes, not DOM tags as data.
entries.accessibility: Keep a keyboard focus target and accessible host command labels. Core input/selection owns IME boundaries.
entries.cancel: Captured commands become invalid after target changes; dispose captures. Read-only rejects edits.
entries.example: extensions: [], formatting: { marks: { bold: { shortcuts: false, controls: false } } }

entries.title: Search and block reorder
entries.options: Both configure() accept no options. Search/reorder state belongs to each attached editor.
entries.dependencies: editac.search@1 and editac.reorder@1; v5 schema. No declared feature prerequisites or conflicts.
entries.conflicts: Duplicate identities reject before root reservation. Custom authored bindings still pass command conflict admission.
entries.cost: Required-input local presenters; no remote resolver or parser. Disabled modules can still contribute to this package eager graph; no zero-byte claim.
entries.input: Project kickoff followed by Due Friday.
entries.action: Select DocumentSearch and BlockReorder individually; search for Friday using the local search presenter.
entries.output: Both tools attach to the selected editor; a sibling with extensions:[] gets neither. Existing text/history is unchanged by configuration.
entries.serialization: Search results and drag UI are transient, not document data. Reorder commits through the shared command/history owner.
entries.accessibility: Use keyboard search navigation and the existing accessible block move controls; drag handles do not own text selection.
entries.cancel: Dispose cancels pending requests/controls. Do not move a block captured before a document revision change.

entries.title: Tables, images and source preservation
entries.kind: semantic content nodes with optional browser presenters
entries.options: Images.configure() and Tables.configure() accept no options. Host asset authority remains outside configuration.
entries.dependencies: editac.images@1 and editac.tables@1; source-fallback capability, v5 admitted module tuples.
entries.conflicts: No declared feature prerequisites/conflicts; duplicates and unknown options reject. Select Markdown separately for Markdown import.
entries.cost: Required-input presenters; selecting an image presenter grants no network service or upload implementation.
entries.input: A table with header head and cell Friday; image source ![Kickoff](https://assets.example.test/kickoff.png).
entries.action: Select Tables and Images, edit the cell to Thursday, then undo.
entries.output: Cell becomes Thursday, then Friday; image data/source stays intact when its asset is unavailable. Missing image is visibly reported.
entries.serialization: The existing table/image module tuples retain original source for unsupported hosts. Imports require a separately selected qualified codec; PDF remains export-only in conversion guides.
entries.accessibility: Cell textareas and image alt text use the existing presenters; image failure retains its source/alt fallback.
entries.cancel: Host uploads/resolution require explicit host permission and cancellation. destroy/report preserves unsaved edits; no data clearing.

entries.title: References and slash menus
entries.options: References.configure({host, triggers?}) requires the existing resolver or version1 permission/catalog/resolve/subscribe host. SlashCommands.configure({commands, literal?}) captures unique command IDs, labels and prepared callbacks.
entries.conflicts: No declared feature conflicts. Prepared intents, permission and stale-range checks remain authoritative. Preserve original configured objects; serialization/spreading loses host bindings.
entries.cost: Required-input menu adapters; resolver/preparation is idle until explicit interaction. No socket/provider is supplied.
entries.input: Due Friday in one editor and an unchanged sibling.
entries.action: Open a local reference menu or Insert kickoff slash action with deterministic host callbacks.
entries.output: Reference selection inserts the returned doc-42/Verified reference tuple; slash inserts bold Kickoff once. Undo restores Due Friday; sibling is unchanged.
entries.serialization: Persist reference identity/label through the existing reference tuple, never callback closures or menu state. Unsafe URL insertion requires the separate validated URL recipe.
entries.accessibility: Use existing keyboard menu navigation, labels and focus restoration. Trigger activation respects composition ownership.
entries.cancel: Closing/disposal or stale target aborts pending work; permission denial does not become document data. No document-open metadata fetch is implied.
entries.example: extensions: [References.configure({ host: localResolver }), SlashCommands.configure({ commands: localCommands })]

entries.title: Markdown, math and highlighting assets
entries.kind: optional parser, data mark and presentation behavior
entries.options: Markdown.configure({input?: boolean}) defaults input:true; input:false defers exporter loading. MathNotation.configure() takes no options. assets is one host baseURL or manifest.
entries.dependencies: Markdown additionally installs @edit-ac/markdown@0.0.0; MathNotation uses the existing math definition and deferred renderer.
entries.conflicts: Facade configuration cannot mix legacy assembly keys. Code/Pairs descriptors remain contract fixtures, with no qualified Code.configure() example. Advanced managedCodeHighlighting is a separate legacy port.
entries.cost: Markdown required input gates ready; command-lazy export waits for its first call. Math renderer/KaTeX starts at first presentation. Highlight worker/backend starts on code. Baseline/core WASM remains required.
entries.input: Literal **Friday** for command-lazy Markdown; existing LaTeX x^2 source for math.
entries.action: Open Markdown with input:false, edit ordinary text, explicitly export; choose MathNotation for a math-marked document.
entries.output: Ordinary input remains literal before export; exporter returns its existing diagnostics/recovery blocks. A missing parser rejects required readiness and preserves the original document.
entries.serialization: Markdown returns codec output without editing its input blocks. Math keeps canonical LaTeX when rendering fails. Code source stays data even when highlighting is absent.
entries.accessibility: Source fallback stays readable; a colorized code view is not a replacement for text or semantic marks.
entries.cancel: loadExtension retry is bounded to three attempts. Disposed generations cannot attach late; after a failed ESM import repair the versioned URL and remount if needed.

entries.title: Compose features and inspect presets
entries.options: defaultPreset() selects no extensions; documentPreset() selects Search+Reorder. Both accept extensions, remove feature IDs and overrides for already selected members.
entries.dependencies: The same v5 engine and individually selected factories. Presets create no independent document/history owner.
entries.conflicts: Duplicate selection fails; overriding an absent feature fails missing-override. Legacy taskPreset and low-level profile names retain their historical contracts.
entries.cost: Cost is the union of actually selected features, baseline engine and host delivery graph. A preset name does not grant hidden assets or services.
entries.input: A local Task/comment/document with Project kickoff text.
entries.action: Choose documentPreset({remove:["editac.reorder"]}) or configure Search alone without a preset.
entries.output: Both attach Search only; formatting and local data/history are preserved, with no collaboration or presence. A Task can select any qualified factory.
entries.serialization: Presets are host configuration, not a schema conversion or content migration. Never strip existing marks/unknown data because a control is hidden.
entries.accessibility: Keep baseline editing and host labels available regardless of selected optional tools.
entries.cancel: Await editor.ready, then await destroy({policy:"flush"}) and inspect failure; borrowed surfaces use dispose() while their engine owner persists.
